title: 121.5 MHz swept-tone beacons: four beacons, AM voice and a carrier on the guard channel
description: Six transmitters in the 32 kHz VFO on 121.500 MHz, 30 s looped: an ELT (downward sweep 1600-300 Hz, 3 sweeps/s, square-wave modulation) on 121.4970 MHz at 40 deg; a 406 MHz beacon's homer (2.5 sweeps/s, pausing 0.5 s every 10 s - real ones every ~50 s - with the Morse 'P' after each pause) on 121.4995 MHz at 150 deg, 6 dB weaker; an upward-sweeping beacon (400-1400 Hz, 2.5/s) on 121.5042 MHz at 260 deg; an old beacon drifted to 121.5105 MHz (+86 ppm, outside the +-50 ppm of the standard) sweeping 4 times a second, at 100 deg; AM voice on 121.5018 MHz (200 deg) and a bare carrier on 121.4920 MHz (320 deg) - neither a beacon. Expect four talkers at their bearings, four '⚠ DISTRESS BEACON' events (121.5105 flagged '+86 ppm (> 50)' in its details), the 406 MHz homer's pause event and its Morse 'P' (after its second pause, ~17 s), and the voice and carrier only under 'Carriers without a sweep'.

title: 121.5 MHz beacon with the Digital squelch: AM voice from another bearing in its silence
description: One ELT (downward sweep, 3 sweeps/s) on 121.5030 MHz at 70 deg, on the air 0-12 s and 20-30 s of the 30 s loop; between, AM voice on 121.5010 MHz from 250 deg. The VFO's squelch is set to Digital: it opens only while the beacon's sweep is confirmed, and the VFO's own DoA (its MUSIC plot) comes from the beacon's samples only - expect it at 70 deg, held there while the voice talks, and the beacon's talker at 70 deg.
